asks: Where do you think the bottom is?
Shall I show you the rate?
description: A polished brass funnel set into the floor, turning inward and downward in a spiral that keeps its proportion the whole way and does not appear to bottom out anywhere you can see.
emotes: {it} turns one full revolution and everything on it moves inward a step.
{it} throws a ring of reflected light up the wall.
{it} tightens, briefly, all the way down.
looks: Every turn is the same shape as the last one and smaller by the same amount, exactly.
The spiral is turning slowly, or the light on it is. You cannot settle which.
Dropping something in, you never hear it stop.
name: a spiral going down out of sight
says: It goes down at the same rate forever.
Do not lean over it for long.
